2. `COC(=O)/C=C(/OC)C(C)Br` -> `CC/C(=C\C(=O)OC)OC.O=C1CCC(=O)N1Br` (Adds Br to methyl)

In all FGA examples, the transformation involves adding a halogen (usually Br or Cl) to an alkyl group (typically methyl -> bromomethyl/chloromethyl), and the reagent is often NBS (`O=C1CCC(=O)N1Br`) or similar.
